Vendored third-party libraries — pinned versions, sources, licenses
=====================================================================

dexie.min.js
  Version: 4.0.11
  Source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dexie@4.0.11/dist/dexie.min.js
  License: Apache-2.0
  Project: https://dexie.org

chart.umd.min.js
  Version: 4.4.7
  Source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.min.js
  License: MIT
  Project: https://www.chartjs.org

xlsx.full.min.js
  Version: 0.18.5
  Source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
  License: Apache-2.0
  Project: https://sheetjs.com

tesseract/tesseract.min.js, tesseract/worker.min.js
  Version: 5.1.1
  Source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tesseract.js@5.1.1/dist/{tesseract,worker}.min.js
  License: Apache-2.0
  Project: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js

tesseract/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js
  Version: 5.1.1 (tesseract.js-core)
  Source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tesseract.js-core@5.1.1/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js
  License: Apache-2.0
  Project: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
  Note: self-contained build (WASM embedded as base64) — no separate .wasm fetch.

tesseract/eng.traineddata.gz
  Version: 4.0.0_fast (LSTM-only, faster/smaller than the legacy 3.04 model)
  Source:  https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast/eng.traineddata.gz
  License: Apache-2.0
  Project: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast

Pinned intentionally: bumping any of these requires re-vendoring and
re-testing offline behavior (the service worker precaches these exact
file names/bytes; the tesseract/ files are intentionally NOT precached —
they're lazy-loaded on first "read weight from photo" use, same as
xlsx.full.min.js, and cached by the fetch handler after that).
